title: Tiny, cute lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <polygon points='52,8 34,52 48,52 40,92 70,42 54,42 62,8' fill='#fff59a' opacity='0.25'/>

    <polygon points='52,10 36,50 49,50 42,90 68,44 55,44 63,10' fill='#ffe13b' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

    <polygon points='51,16 40,46 48,46 44,78 62,46 54,46 60,16' fill='#fff8b0' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#5a3a00'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#5a3a00'/>
  <circle cx='47.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 50 54 46' stroke='#5a3a00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='2.4' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='46' r='2.4' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#fff59a'/>

  <circle cx='74' cy='62' r='1.6' fill='#fff59a'/>

</svg>
